note: Ivy or US News 2026 overall top 20 only. Rice removed. MIT / Princeton / Yale / Stanford / Caltech have no fully online CS master's. Harvard's only mostly-online option is Extension School (diploma says Extension Studies, not a Harvard SEAS MS). Among these online programs, none currently require the GRE — they are split into 'not required' vs 'optional (a score can help)'. Deadlines checked Nov 8, 2026; Spring 2027 dates that already passed are omitted.

schools.deadline: Rolling. Apply by Oct 1 for spring / Mar 1 for summer / Jun 1 for fall (suggested, not hard cuts). Spring 2027 class starts Jan 25 — apply ASAP if you want that term.
schools.why: US News #7. Built for working engineers/scientists. Physics + SWE is a normal admit. Free to apply.
schools.fitNote: Same JHU name. Decisions in about 2–3 weeks.

schools.deadline: Autumn 2027 online: final June 23, 2027. Portal can close early if the cohort fills.
schools.why: US News #6. Physics + SWE is a normal profile. Evening classes work if you stay in Chicago.
schools.fitNote: UChicago's actual online master's. MPCS (CS) is in-person only.
schools.notes: In-person ADS has earlier priority dates; this row is the online program only.

schools.deadline: Spring 2027: Nov 15, 2026 (extended — 1 week from now). Summer 2027: Apr 1, 2027. Fall 2027: Apr 15 priority / Jun 15 final.
schools.why: US News #17. Same diploma as campus MSCS. Built for working professionals.
schools.fitNote: They describe the audience as CS or engineering background. Your SWE job helps; physics is adjacent, not a perfect undergrad match.
schools.notes: Optional twice-a-year Nashville meetups. If you want January 2027, the deadline is Nov 15.

schools.degree: Master of Liberal Arts (Extension Studies) in Computer Science
schools.format: 11 of 12 courses online; 1 required 3-week Harvard campus summer course
schools.deadline: No normal app. Register for 2 admission courses (Java II + Data Structures), get a B or better, then apply in the semester of the second course. Spring 2027 course registration closes Jan 19, 2027.
schools.why: Harvard name, no GRE, you earn admission by passing two classes.
schools.fitNote: Honest catch: the diploma says Harvard Extension School / Master of Liberal Arts in Extension Studies, not a Harvard SEAS MS. Employers who know the difference will see that.
schools.notes: Fall 2026 degree-application window is Nov 1–Dec 1, 2026 if you already finished the two courses.

schools.deadline: Fall 2027: priority Mar 1, 2027; final May 31, 2027; classes Aug 2027. Spring 2027 deadline (Oct 26, 2026) already passed.
schools.why: Ivy, US News #10. Official path: physics degree + 2+ years as a software engineer.
schools.fitNote: Best Penn fit. Skip MSE-AI — they want a CS/CE undergrad degree. GRE only useful if your undergrad grades were weak.

schools.deadline: Fall 2027: priority Mar 1, 2027; final May 31, 2027. Spring 2027 deadline already passed.
schools.why: Ivy, built for non-CS majors. Physics covers the quant bar.
schools.fitNote: Easiest Ivy admit — coursework starts at CS foundations and may feel basic after Capital One.

schools.gre: Optional — not required (no penalty if omitted)
schools.deadline: Fall 2027 start: apply Mar 3–May 5, 2027. January 2027 deadline (Oct 14, 2026) already passed.
schools.why: US News #20. Built for working software engineers. Physics counts as technical undergrad.
schools.fitNote: Diploma: Master of Science – Software Engineering (does not say online). There is a coding assessment after you apply.

schools.deadline: Fall 2027: Feb 15, 2027. Spring 2027 deadline (Oct 15, 2026) already passed.
schools.why: Ivy, US News #15. Same Columbia Engineering MS as on-campus.
schools.fitNote: Work does not waive 6 for-credit prereqs (4 CS + 2 math). Physics covers math; you likely still need university CS courses (not Coursera). Their non-CS Bridge is in-person only.
